doc.name: G — 30s product demo arc set in a industrial port, suspenseful in tone, a lone traveller, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: product demo arc set in a industrial port, suspenseful in tone
Hero: a lone traveller
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the product demo arc set in an industrial port, suspenseful in tone form, built around a lone traveller.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Any on-screen text must use the same wording and placement logic in every act.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a boom-down from a high wide to a tight insert in Act 1 against a top-down descent onto a flat plane in Act 3 — while holding the a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second product demo arc set in an industrial port, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same lone traveller.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a top-down descent onto a flat plane, shot on a 50mm anamorphic with 2x squeeze at f/4, framed with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a projected gobo throwing a broken pattern across the background; grade as near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second product demo arc set in an industrial port, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same lone traveller.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a low-mounted tracking shot skimming just above the ground, shot on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm at f/2, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject; grade as a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second product demo arc set in an industrial port, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same lone traveller.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a jib reveal rising over a foreground object, shot on a 50mm normal at f/1.8, framed with diagonal dynamic balance across the frame.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a projected gobo throwing a broken pattern across the background; grade as a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
